name: Hinted scaling laws forecast benchmarks stuck near zero
title: Hinted scaling laws forecast benchmarks stuck near zero
summary: Hinted scaling laws give smaller models partial solutions so accuracy rises above zero, then use that curve to predict larger models. Across GSM8K, AIME, and HLE, median forecasting error falls from 21 to 4.3 percentage points.
